integrity: Mathematical proof by carry/valuation identities; bounded finite checks are auxiliary and do not prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-sided binary digit-sum word reduced modulo m>=3 is considered. The proof establishes no reflected pairs of factors of length at least 4, but does not give a closed form for ordinary factor complexity beyond length 3.
title: Reversal-freeness at length four for every nonbinary digit-sum residue word
